qa.note: 工厂修复次数不等于 Agent 开发中的全部自测和修正；未记录 Agent 内部试错，不宣称开发全程无错误。

reviews.reason: 独立 Agent 评审完成；评分是基于本次证据的意见，不替代业务 QA 或人工评审。
reviews.summary: 以 5 个框架能力单元评审本 Run 的搭建过程：记录生命周期状态机、权限与记录级数据范围、通知与站内信、服务注册与依赖解析、数据库迁移与种子。四个单元由框架原生能力直接支撑并有多处实现证据（lifecycle 的 state+version 条件更新与 effect 作业、record access 的查询层强制、通知幂等与收件人校验、迁移锁与 checksum），QA 实测 C01 通过。主要问题是 @nocobase/service-provider 的 resolveIfCreated 对“已注册未创建”的 singleton 静默返回 undefined，类型声明与 Skill 均未说明，导致应用通知全部静默丢失，Agent 需读 dist 源码并用临时测试定位后改为 has()+resolve()；另有日志 helper 未在指引中出现导致依赖错位、lifecycle trigger 无法表达跨状态 SLA 两处次要问题。68 个错误信号已逐条归类：绝大多数为路径猜测/编辑工具摩擦/自建脚本/工厂与验收环境约束，仅 1 处与框架文档相关、1 处属工厂脚本缺陷。

modules.name: 记录生命周期状态机（@nocobase/lifecycle 与生命周期 Skill）
modules.scope: 工单从提交到确认关闭的流程：状态/转移/守卫/输入校验/提交后副作用/可配置参数/历史与流程图。框架侧只看 @nocobase/lifecycle 的运行时、存储与触发器约定，以及对应的 Skill 指引。
modules.limitations: 只评估了工单用到的状态机能力；并行分支、子流程与 onEnterState/onLeaveState 子任务未在本次业务中出现，未验证。

requirements.need: 六状态工单流转（待分派/已分派/处理中/待确认/关闭/退回）与退回后继续处理
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供声明式状态机与 runtime.fire，只有 runtime 在事务内改写状态字段
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 defineLifecycle 中声明 states/transitions，业务服务只调用 runtime.fire 执行转移
requirements.actualUsage: app/server/lifecycles/ticket.ts 用 defineLifecycle 声明状态与转移，服务与路由通过 runtime 执行，未自行改状态字段

requirements.need: 每个转移的权限判定、必填输入（解决方案/退回原因）与附带字段写入
requirements.responsibility: guard/validate/accept/set 由框架在转移事务内按序执行，并返回可读错误
requirements.recommendedUsage: guard 返回 true 或 {code,message}，validate 返回字段级错误，accept 列出允许写入的字段
requirements.actualUsage: 指派/确认/退回转移声明 accept 与 guard；前端按 available 决定按钮，后端独立校验

requirements.need: 转移后通知相关人，且通知失败不得回滚业务状态
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供提交后执行的 effect（重试/超时/onFailure）
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把外部副作用写成 defineEffect 并挂在 effects/onEnter 上
requirements.actualUsage: 指派、处理、退回、关闭等转移各挂 assignmentEffects/resolutionEffect 等 effect，由 runtime 在提交后派发

requirements.need: 工单超过 24 小时未解决时提醒服务台，且阈值可由管理员调整
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 triggers（状态停留 after）与可配置 parameters；跨状态累计时长由 jobs+service 承担
requirements.recommendedUsage: 状态内计时用 triggers；跨状态累计用定时扫描服务，阈值放进 parameters
requirements.actualUsage: 阈值走 parameters.overdueHours；提醒用 TicketService.remindOverdue 手写扫描 + 每日 schedule，而不是 trigger

requirements.need: 状态变更历史与流程可视化
requirements.responsibility: runtime 记录 history/transitions 并提供 description/available 供管理页渲染
requirements.recommendedUsage: 读 runtime 的 description/available/history 渲染，不要自行推断已走过的边
requirements.actualUsage: 交付工作流管理页，使用 workflow-management block 与 LifecycleDiagram 展示 5 状态/10 转移与参数

requirementFit.reason: 五条需求全部落地：状态机、守卫/校验、提交后副作用、可配置阈值与流程图都用了框架原生构件；只有“跨状态累计 24 小时”需要手写扫描，属正常组合而非缺口。

usability.reason: 定义在模块加载时即校验（不可达状态、无出口、最终态有出口都会报错），字段与错误码清楚，前端可据 available 直接渲染；但跨状态计时与重开次数这类语义要读 runtime 行为才能确认，指引的对照表只覆盖状态内计时。

agentFriendliness.reason: Agent 读 lifecycle.md/lifecycle-ui.md 即可写出定义，未读 dist 源码；仅 guard 与 accept 的组合处有一次试探。

design.reason: 状态只存记录字段、无独立流程实例，effect 在提交后派发、重试与幂等键齐备，作业注册顺序也考虑了跨进程恢复，职责边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 存储层用 state+version 条件更新防止并发覆盖，effect 派发作业在 setup 前注册以免丢单；读到的实现与 README 承诺一致。

modules.name: 权限模型与记录级数据范围（authorization 插件与指引）

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/authorization.md
entrypoints: optional plugins must come from installed Skills

modules.scope: 员工/工程师/服务台三角色在页面、操作与记录级数据范围上的权限：record access 解析、权限集授权、后端强制与 UI 可见性。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖字段级读写、共享规则与限制规则插件（应用未启用）；策略执行链路的性能与 SQL 下推未评估。

requirements.need: 员工只看自己提交的工单，工程师只看指派给自己的，服务台看全部
requirements.responsibility: record access 用 principal 解析出记录选择（true/false/条件/filter），由 db 在查询层强制
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineRecordAccess(key, ...) 返回基于当前用户的条件；权限集用 options()/default() 绑定具体范围
requirements.actualUsage: resources.ts 定义 allTickets/reportedByMe/assignedToMe 三个 record access，工单读写权限 .default(allTicketsAccess)，权限集在种子中选择范围

requirements.need: 页面与操作按钮按角色可见，且后端独立校验
requirements.responsibility: 插件提供页面 authz 声明、useCan 与服务端 authorize/policy 绑定
requirements.recommendedUsage: 路由 authorize + repository policy；页面声明 authz 并用 useCan 控制可见性
requirements.actualUsage: 页面声明 authz 与 useCan；资源权限用 defineDatabasePermission 绑定到 repository，QA 实测三角色列表隔离正确

requirements.need: 权限模型随应用初始化，而不是在界面上手工点击
requirements.responsibility: 插件提供 permission set/grant 的种子契约与启动期校验
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 definePermissionSet/defineSeed 写数据，让启动扫描报告无效 grant
requirements.actualUsage: seed-data 用 encodeAuthorizationTitle + definePermissionSet 初始化三套权限集，QA 打开角色页确认角色存在

requirements.need: 可选的授权插件（默认访问/共享/限制规则）缺失时不得臆造其 API
requirements.responsibility: 指引要求以已安装 Skill 为准，缺失即视为不支持
requirements.recommendedUsage: 先确认包与 Skill 同时存在再接入
requirements.actualUsage: 应用未启用这些可选插件，也未自建替代表

requirementFit.reason: 三角色数据范围、页面可见性与权限种子全部由插件原生能力实现，QA 实测“员工 1 张/工程师仅被指派/服务台全部”成立。

usability.reason: fluent API 的 scopeKey/options/default 语义在指引里有明确定义，缺失字段会在启动扫描报错；但 record access 的适用集合与 default 的宽松语义需要读完类型声明才能完全把握。

agentFriendliness.reason: Agent 主要读 fluent-registration/business-module 指引即可实现，但中间为 composite 与 reference 类型多次 grep 声明文件，说明 API 面较大。

design.reason: 记录选择与授权解耦（resolver 只返回选择、不接触数据库对象），权限在查询层强制而非前端隐藏，复合资源与条件可组合。

reliability.reason: record access 定义缺 key/resolver/collections 会立即抛错，启动期校验会报告不再适用的 grant；错误路径清晰，但本次未深读策略执行全链路。

modules.name: 通知发送与站内信（notification / in-app 插件与指引）
modules.scope: 工单事件的通知：消息契约、幂等、收件人校验、详情跳转与实时未读。
modules.limitations: 邮件/飞书等外部渠道未配置，未实测；实时推送因验收环境缺少 WebSocket 静态常量只做了页面级验证。

requirements.need: 指派/处理完成/退回/关闭时通知对应人员
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供统一 send 入口与按渠道配置的消息契约
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 effect 中 resolve notificationServiceToken 后按用户 ID 发送
requirements.actualUsage: 工单转移的 effect 内调用 TicketNotifier，向被指派工程师/报修人发送站内信

requirements.need: 通知可点击直达对应工单
requirements.responsibility: in-app 消息支持 target route，由前端路由解析
requirements.recommendedUsage: inbox 消息带 target:{type:"route", path:"/tickets/<id>"}
requirements.actualUsage: QA 实测点击站内信打开 /main/tickets/<id>

requirements.need: effect 重试不得重复发同一条通知
requirements.responsibility: 框架按 idempotencyKey 与请求指纹去重，同键不同请求抛冲突
requirements.recommendedUsage: 为每条业务通知生成稳定幂等键（如转移+记录 ID）
requirements.actualUsage: 通知调用携带 idempotencyKey，QA 观察到通知不重复

requirements.need: 通知插件未注册时工单流程仍可运行
requirements.responsibility: 框架用 provider/token 装配，应用可对可选依赖降级
requirements.recommendedUsage: 对可选服务先判存在再使用，缺失时记录并跳过通知
requirements.actualUsage: TicketNotifier 通过 has(notificationServiceToken)?resolve():undefined 的回调注入，缺失时不发通知

requirementFit.reason: 发送契约、幂等、站内信路由与实时未读均由插件提供，QA 实测三角色收件箱与跳转正确。

usability.reason: 消息契约的校验规则（收件人形状、title/body、target 前缀）在指引里写得很细，幂等键复用规则也明确；但“如何取得服务实例”只给了 resolve 一句，取得方式的坑记在依赖解析单元。

agentFriendliness.reason: 按指引即可写出 send 调用；实际接入时因解析方式在通知不落地的情况下反复试错（详见依赖解析单元与 F1）。

design.reason: 发送、幂等、渠道注册与站内信存储分层清楚，实时主题与持久化可组合，渠道定义可扩展。

reliability.reason: send 前置校验严格，幂等冲突显式抛错，站内信投递前再次校验收件人存在；错误路径可预期。

modules.name: 服务注册与依赖解析（service-provider 与 services-and-jobs 指引）

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/services-and-jobs.md
entrypoints: singleton 首次 resolve 构建

modules.scope: 服务提供者装配与运行期依赖解析：token/container 语义、provider 生命周期钩子、日志诊断接入，以及 Skill 对这些的说明。
modules.limitations: 未评估多实例/作用域容器与 provider 钩子的失败恢复细节；日志只做了接入，未验证脱敏与采样配置。

requirements.need: 业务服务在 provider 中注册、在路由与 lifecycle effect 中按 token 解析
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 token 身份、container 与 provider 生命周期钩子
requirements.recommendedUsage: register() 里用 singleton 注册，使用时 container.resolve(token)
requirements.actualUsage: TicketServiceProvider 用 ServiceProvider 子类注册 ticketServiceToken，并在 boot() 中构建 runtime 与 jobs

requirements.need: 可选插件（通知/授权）缺失时应能判空而不是抛错
requirements.responsibility: 框架应提供语义明确的判空入口，并在文档中说明“已注册未创建”与“未注册”的区别
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按文档选择 has+resolve 或 resolveIfCreated；仅在需要“已创建实例”时用后者
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 先用 resolveIfCreated(notificationServiceToken) 导致通知静默丢失，读 dist 源码后改为 has()?resolve():undefined；authz/logging 仍用 resolveIfCreated

requirements.need: 运行期结构化日志接入
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 loggingToken/getLogger，以及可在 App 日志就绪前使用的诊断日志桥
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 loggingToken 取 logger；需要 message-first 时用 createDiagnosticLogger
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 import createDiagnosticLogger 并配 loggingToken；该 helper 未在指引中出现，导致包被放进 devDependencies，构建期被框架依赖校验拦下后修正

requirementFit.reason: token 身份、singleton/instance、provider 生命周期与日志 token 覆盖了本次全部装配需求，构建期还有依赖一致性校验兜底。

usability.reason: resolveIfCreated 的名字容易被读成“存在即返回”，但实现只返回已创建实例：singleton 注册后未解析前一律 undefined。这个区分没有 JSDoc、没有指引说明，公开 API 静默返回 undefined 会让调用方悄悄丢功能。

agentFriendliness.reason: Agent 需要 cat dist/container.js 源码才确认语义，并靠多轮临时测试定位“发送成功但收件箱为空”；指引与类型声明都没能预防这一错误。

design.reason: container 的 pending/creating/created/failed 状态机、循环依赖报错与失败重放设计干净，框架自身也用 has()+resolve() 处理可选依赖；但两个语义相近的解析入口缺少文档约束，把易错点留给了调用者。

reliability.reason: 创建失败会记录 error 并在后续 resolve 重抛，循环依赖有显式报错，finally 复位解析栈；这部分实现读过后判断可靠。

modules.name: 数据库结构、迁移与种子（@nocobase/db 与迁移 Skill）
modules.scope: 工单/留言/生命周期历史的表结构与索引、迁移与初始化种子，以及校验和漂移与修复路径。
modules.limitations: 未实测多连接目录、迁移中途失败恢复与 checksum 漂移的实际修复流程。

requirements.need: 工单、留言与生命周期历史表结构及索引（含 status/statusChangedAt/lifecycleVersion）
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 Collection Builder 与迁移定义，索引/唯一约束声明式创建
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 defineMigration 的 up 中用 builder.createCollection 建表并声明索引
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 database/main/migrations 下建表并声明索引，运行时由 lifecycle 使用 status/statusChangedAt/version

requirements.need: 迁移自包含且合并后不可变，避免历史漂移
requirements.responsibility: 框架记录迁移历史并校验 checksum，锁定执行
requirements.recommendedUsage: 一个迁移只做一件事，已合并的迁移不再修改
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移按时间戳命名、逐个自包含，后续变更新增迁移文件

requirements.need: 权限集/角色等初始化数据随部署安装
requirements.responsibility: 框架区分迁移与种子，种子只插数据且只跑 pending
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineSeed 写安装所需数据，演示数据用 sample 前缀
requirements.actualUsage: seed-data 初始化角色与三套权限集，随 db apply 一起安装

requirements.need: 校验和漂移可发现并有修复路径
requirements.responsibility: 框架在迁移时比较已应用历史的 checksum 并给出警告/升级路径
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 db redo 重放；不要手改已应用迁移
requirements.actualUsage: 本次未触发漂移，但按指引保留了不可变迁移与 checksum 校验路径

requirementFit.reason: 表结构、索引、迁移与种子全部由框架原生构件完成，权限初始化也走种子契约。

usability.reason: 迁移/种子的职责划分与目录约定清楚，db apply 只跑 pending；checksum 漂移有明确指引，但“编译产物清单”一类部署细节仍偏重。

agentFriendliness.reason: Agent 读 migrations.md 与 nocobase-db SKILL.md 后直接写迁移，未出现结构性返工。

design.reason: 迁移（结构）与种子（数据）分离，锁定执行 + 历史表 + checksum 校验，任务上下文只暴露受控能力。

reliability.reason: 迁移在锁内执行、按 name 幂等跳过、分批写历史并校验 checksum，重复执行安全；本次未覆盖失败中断后的恢复。

findings.title: resolveIfCreated 对“已注册但未创建”的 singleton 静默返回 undefined，类型与指引都未说明
findings.detail: @nocobase/service-provider 的 ServiceContainer 在 singleton 注册后把 state 置为 pending，只有 resolve 成功才置 created；resolveIfCreated 仅在 created 时返回实例（container.js 的 singleton/resolve/resolveIfCreated）。公开声明 container.d.ts 没有任何 JSDoc 区分“未注册”与“已注册未创建”，名字又极易被理解为“已存在就返回”。services-and-jobs.md 只演示 container.resolve；migrations.md 是唯一提到 resolveIfCreated 的地方，且只说明“无源容器时返回 undefined”。应用侧 TicketServiceProvider 先用 resolveIfCreated(notificationServiceToken) 判空，通知因此全部静默丢弃，Agent 读 dist 源码后才改为 has()?resolve():undefined。框架自身（notification provider 对 authorizationToken、in-app provider 对 realtime/registry token、authorization provider 对 databaseManagerToken）用的正是 has()+resolve()。
findings.impact: 调用方按名字直觉使用公开 API 会静默丢失功能（本 Run 是通知全部不发出），且只能靠读 dist 源码定位，显著增加试错成本。

## Resolving services

Migration callbacks and seed `run` also receive `container`, a `ServiceResolver` exposing `has(token)`, `resolve(token)`, and `resolveIfCreated(token)`. Application task runners wrap the application container with a token-identity allowlist; only `idGeneratorToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/id-generator` is currently allowed. Use `container.resolve(idGeneratorToken).generateString()` for string IDs or `.generate()` for numeric IDs. Disallowed tokens return false from `has` and throw from both resolution methods. The wrapper reuses application singleton instances and exposes no registration methods. Startup and CLI share the application factory in `server/app.ts`, which registers `IdGeneratorProvider`; CLI database commands call the application factory discovered from `rootDir/server/app.ts` (or `.js` in compiled applications), register its providers without booting or starting them, and use its database manager and migration contributions. They dispose the application and runtime scope after execution, including failure and cancellation. Keep the factory free of startup side effects; CLI does not call `app.start()` or trigger autoRun. Services must therefore be usable after provider registration; do not depend on later boot/start hooks. Direct application and database runners accept a `container` option. Without a source container, an allowed token returns false from `has`, undefined from `resolveIfCreated`, and a missing-service error from `resolve`. Standalone `@nocobase/db` runners accept an owner-supplied resolver; the application allowlist is enforced by `app-server`, including direct `createAppMigrator` and `createAppSeeder` calls.

Use the callback's `query` and `builder` for transactional database work. Services resolved from the container are application-scoped and are not automatically rebound to the migration or seed transaction. Keep historical schema definitions self-contained rather than delegating them to evolving application services.

应用侧 TicketServiceProvider：logging/authz 用 resolveIfCreated 判空，而通知依赖改为 has(notificationServiceToken)?resolve():undefined，并在注释里写明“懒注册的 singleton 若用 resolveIfCreated 会一直报缺失、每条通知都会被丢弃”。这是 F1 的实际使用与绕行记录。

随后 Agent 用 sed 把应用里的 resolveIfCreated 改成 has(token)?resolve(token):undefined，通知立即通过（scratch 测试返回 notificationId）。

# Record lifecycles

Use `@nocobase/lifecycle` when a business record moves through stages that developers define in source: an expense report, a ticket, a contract, an order, a leave request. The record keeps its state in one of its own fields, every change is a transition declared in a definition, and the work a transition owes outside the database — mail, payments, calls to other systems — runs as effects after the transaction commits. There is no separate process instance, so the state is never kept in two places.

Administrators can adjust code-declared business parameters without editing workflow structure. Proactively declare suitable approval departments, reviewer choices and thresholds as business parameters, even without an explicit configurability request. For declarations, snapshot/live reads and shared configuration editors, read [configurable lifecycle parameters](lifecycle-parameters.md).

## Deliver workflow management by default

Whenever application requirements include a process to develop, include workflow management pages alongside its business operations; users do not need to request a console separately. Reuse or extend existing management pages with the UI Library `workflow-management` block and follow [Lifecycle UI](lifecycle-ui.md) for the default layout and organization based on the workflow example. Deliver one Workflow management sidebar entry with in-page Definitions and Executions tabs, definition details with diagrams and declared parameter settings, and execution details with history and effects. The tab views have URL-backed child routes without sidebar `navigation`. Follow the scope exceptions in [system administration](system-administration.md#default-delivery). Keep workflow structure in source; management pages do not imply a visual designer.

## Choose it or something else

The definition is checked when the module loads: an unreachable state, a non-final state without a way out, or a final state with one throws `INVALID_DEFINITION`. Pick the building block by what the requirement says:

| The requirement says                                              | Write                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Only some people may do it, and the page should say why not       | `guard` returning `true`, or `{ code, message, kind? }`; `kind: 'precondition'` when nobody may until the record changes    |
| The action needs input such as a reason                           | `validate` returning `[{ field, message }]`, and `accept: ['field']` to write it onto the record                            |
| Other fields change with the state                                | `set(context)`; it runs after `accept` and wins on the same field                                                           |
| One button, several destinations (by amount, by type)             | `to: ['a', 'b']` and `route(context)` returning one                                                                         |
| Record a change without changing the state (reassign, escalate)   | A self-transition, `from` equal to `to`; the version moves and a trigger's wait restarts                                    |
| Available from almost any state                                   | `from: '*'` or `from: { except: [...] }`                                                                                    |
| Something happens after N hours idle                              | A trigger with `when` and `after(parameters)`, firing a transition marked `manual: false`                                   |
| Call an outside system, then move on                              | An effect with `retry`, `timeoutMs`, `onSuccess` / `onFailure`; throw `EffectFailure(code, message, { details })` to branch |
| Always do X when entering a state, whichever transition got there | `onEnter: { state: [effect] }`                                                                                              |
| Write rows of other tables with the change                        | `onTransition(context)`, in the same transaction, writing through `context.transactionHandle`                               |
| Rows that belong to a stay, such as the tasks a stage opens       | `onEnterState` / `onLeaveState` on the lifecycle or on the state itself                                                     |
| Only server code, a webhook or a vote may conclude it             | `manual: false` on the transition                                                                                           |
| Several records move together                                     | `runtime.transaction(async (tx) => { … })`                                                                                  |

evidence.excerpt:
`grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a reusable permission to one data scope of the action. The key is stored as `scopeKey` and names the data scope a grant or rule fills with a record selection. The title defaults to the permission's explicit title, or the collection name; override it when one action uses the same collection twice. Different keys allow independent multi-collection configuration. Repeated keys and operations are rejected. A business action composes only `database.collection` grants. `read` describes output fields, while `create` and `update` describe input fields. `delete()` takes no fields. Use `'*'` or `.allFields()` explicitly for all fields; for `create` and `update` that means every field a write may set, leaving out auto-increment, generated and optimistic-lock version columns. Never list one of those, or a field that does not exist, in a `create` or `update` list: db refuses the whole Policy, so every write would fail, and the startup scan reports it. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` limits the record access a grant may choose and keeps the option names typed on the resource reference; `.default(reference)` sets the value used when a grant chooses nothing. The references must apply to the selected collection. Omitting options offers every registered record access that applies. Define record access with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register it with `authz.recordAccess.define(access)`. Use `.collections(...names)` for applicability (`'*'` for every collection), `.params

(schema)` for typed parameters and `.resolver(fn)` for evaluation. ## Turn requirements into a matrix

Record actor/job, page, business operation, data scope, readable/writable fields, relation capabilities and administrator responsibilities. Use real jobs as permission sets and business relationships as scopes. Clarify material missing boundaries, such as whether a delegate can submit as well as edit, and whether a confidentiality restriction must cover every operation.

Keep page access independent from business action grants. Distinguish operations that can touch the same table: editing a draft may update amount/notes while submission only changes state after checking the parent project. A user can hold both a personal job and a team job; revoking the team source should preserve unrelated personal responsibilities.

## Implement in application-owned files

For new and existing features alike, classify the requested changes by content. Supported operations, fields/relations, resolver behavior and enforcement belong to the model; selecting supported scopes/parameters, grants, rules and recipients belongs to configuration. A request can require both. When developing a permission model, also complete its usable initial or adjusted business configuration from the responsibility matrix; do not stop at declarations unless the user explicitly asks for model-only work. Clarify unknown recipients without guessing assignments.

Declare reusable collection permissions and business operations, defined as composite resources, in a feature module. In `server/providers/`, resolve `authorizationToken`, then register collections (`authz.database.collections.add`), composites (`authz.compositeResources.define`), record access (`authz.recordAccess.define`), settings items (`authz.settings.add`) and, when the feature owns a team or department model, inherited subjects (`authz.subjects.add`, built as [an organisation dimension](organization.md)); add workspace subsections with `authz.ui.sections.add` and list each composite or settings item in one with `authz.ui.place`. Pages are not registered on the server; the client routes list them. Read the authorization Skill’s bundled `references/code-and-seeds.md` before choosing initialization: code declares capabilities, provider boot registers them, and seeds initialize the agreed business configuration for fresh installations. Use authorized services or controlled data changes for existing installations. Seeded permission sets, selected scopes, rules and assignments remain editable in the backend; seeds do not make them code-owned or protected. App features own composite declarations and initial business configuration, not root/member protection or other platform permission configuration. Never rewrite administrator configuration at boot. Normal seeds have a restricted database context, not the running authorization service. Keep schema changes in migrations and initial assignments in idempotent seeds or controlled provisioning. Do not create a plugin package for an application-owned feature.

Every `server/routes/` endpoint installs authentication and authorization. A business operation checks `{ resource: { type: 'composite', id }, action }` with the request context's `authorize` once and binds each returned `conditions.database` policy through `repository.withPolicy`. Do not replace it with collection-level authorization or an in-memory filter. Use `authz.database.policyFor` for collection CRUD and `authz.database.authorizeRepository` for simple business Repository routes, mapping each method to its composite action. The authorization Skill documents these choices and their contracts.

Declare `authz` on the first page of every path in `client/routes.ts`: `{ resource: { type: 'page', id }, action: 'access' }` for a business page, the page's `settings` item for a configuration page, `'unrestricted'` for a root-only page, or `'skip'` explicitly; nothing is inferred from the route name. Nested pages inherit it; an omitted value on a first page defaults to `'unrestricted'` for protected pages and `'skip'` otherwise, with a development warning. Use `useCan({ resource, action })` for button visibility and server-computed eligibility for record-sensitive actions. Keep pending/failed checks closed and refresh after permission changes. Client visibility does not enforce the API. The authorization Skill’s `references/client-development.md` includes the component, relation controls and settings lifecycle; all required APIs are bundled in that Skill rather than external package documentation.

The permission workspace edits page grants, business actions with their data scopes, and settings items. Field and relation capabilities are code-owned. A new field or workflow must update its declaration and enforcement; it is not an administrator entering arbitrary database grants. Follow the dedicated Skill for custom record access, multi-table transactions, relation targets, protected assignments and last-administrator checks.

# Migrations and seeds

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.
